name: Longer Nano Pro 12W
tagline: Fast portable Longer : 12W with high traverse and rotary options
tldr: Longer Nano Pro 12W is a premium portable diode with very high advertised speeds and rotary/slide accessories. Niche machine for makers who need portability with more punch than 6W minis.
mainObjective: High-quality hobby and light-business engraving with light, slow cutting

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Fast portable Longer : 12W with high traverse and rotary options
Open-frame layout : laser glasses and ventilation are your responsibility
Work area 130 × 130 mm (extendable with slide) on this chassis
12W on Longer Nano Pro: engraving-first : photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Reference engrave job on this module: ~12–18 min
Reference cut job on this module: ~6–10 min
cons: This module targets thin cuts (about 5 mm basswood class) : not thick production plywood
Not the SKU for a shop cutting 5 mm+ stock all day
Open frame: kids, pets, and smoke are not contained
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 12W module on Longer Nano Pro. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Run material test grids at engraving speeds first. Add air assist for light cuts. If cut jobs exceed ~30% of your week, open the higher-watt profile on this site and compare times.
